history.subject: Chevrolet Motor Car Company founded 3 Nov 1911 by Swiss-born racing driver Louis Chevrolet (b. 25 Dec 1878, La Chaux-de-Fonds), his brother Arthur and William C. Durant (Wikipedia Louis Chevrolet + Chevrolet; MotorCities 'organized on Nov. 3, 1911'). Louis disagreed with Durant over the car's design and in 1915 sold Durant his share (Britannica, Wikipedia; MotorCities says they parted in 1914). Gulf News: Durant wanted a cheaper car; Louis did not want his name on cheap cars (single source -> 'deyilənə görə'). Lost his money (Gulf News: 1929 crash), in 1936 returned to the GM division named for him as a minor employee (Britannica; Gulf News 'regular employee at GM'). Died 6 Jun 1941, Detroit (Britannica, MotorCities). His cars won Indianapolis 500 in 1920 (driven by brother Gaston) and 1921 (MotorCities, Britannica). Brand now part of General Motors.

facts.subject: Maiden Tower (Qız qalası), Baku: 8 floors (Wikipedia; icherisheher.gov.az 'divided into 8 floors'); height 29.5 m (Wikipedia; Coin World '97-foot'); icherisheher.gov.az: 31 m north, 28 m south -> 'təxminən 30 metr'. Base diameter 16.5 m (both). Walls 5 m thick at base (both; top 3.2-4.5 m). 1962-63 excavations: built on a large rock sloping toward the sea; the buttress projecting from the tower gives stability (Wikipedia + icherisheher.gov.az). Water well inside (0.7 m wide; Wikipedia 21 m deep vs icherisheher 13 m -> no depth given). Mostly 12th century per Wikipedia (dating disputed, older theories). On the 10-manat note: front shows Old Baku, Shirvanshahs' Palace and Maiden Tower (BanknoteWorld P-27 2005; Coin World 2022 new design; Wikipedia).

facts.subject: Olympus Mons, Mars: 26 km above the surrounding plains, 'three times taller than Mt. Everest' (NASA JPL PIA23928, 2020); EBSCO 25.7 km, 'nearly three times'; Wikipedia: 21.3 km above Mars datum (MOLA), ~26 km from Amazonis plains. Width 585 km (JPL) / ~600 km (EBSCO, Wikipedia), wider than Arizona (JPL). Area ~300 000 km2 ≈ Italy (Wikipedia). Basal cliff up to 8 km (Wikipedia; EBSCO 9.7 km). Slopes only 2-5 degrees (JPL). Curvature of Mars + the volcano hide the whole view from the surface (Wikipedia). Tallest volcano in the solar system (JPL).

facts.subject: Angel Falls, Venezuela: total height 979 m, longest drop 807 m; world's tallest uninterrupted waterfall (some uncertainty vs Tugela) (Wikipedia). Named after US aviator Jimmie Angel, first to fly over it in Nov 1933 (Wikipedia 16 Nov; Linda Hall 18 Nov -> no day). 9 Oct 1937 he landed his monoplane 'El Río Caroní' on top of Auyán-tepui; wheels sank in marshy ground/soft mud; he, his wife Marie and two companions walked down; took 11 days (Wikipedia + Linda Hall). Plane stayed on top 33 years, lifted by helicopter (1970, Linda Hall), now outside Ciudad Bolívar airport (Wikipedia + Linda Hall). Height surveyed 1949 (Ruth Robertson expedition, Wikipedia). Pemon name Kerepakupai Vená (Wikipedia).

Reasons: travel to the polls could take a day or longer (CBS/whytuesday.org); Monday ruled out because people would have to travel on Sunday, a day of rest (NPR, Mental Floss); Wednesday was market day (NPR, Mental Floss, CBS). November: harvest finished, winter not yet (Mental Floss). Neutral explainer, no parties/candidates/predictions (section D/T).

Monday/Sunday-rest and Wednesday-market reasons: NPR + Mental Floss (CBS quotes whytuesday.org). 'a day or longer' travel: CBS/whytuesday.org only -> 'bəzən daha çox'. Harvest/November: Mental Floss only (caption only). '181 il' = 2026-1845. Neutral: no party, candidate, poll or prediction. Wording 'Bazar günü istirahət günü idi' avoids the religion angle. backup_unused.subject: Burj Khalifa, Dubai: 828 m tall; highest occupiable floor 585 m; the top 244 m (29%) is 'vanity height' - unusable spire (CTBUH 2013 study via Reuters/VOA 5 Sep 2013; Gulf News; Wikipedia Vanity height + Burj Khalifa). The 244 m alone 'would rank on its own as the 11th tallest building in Europe' (Reuters/VOA 2013; Gulf News). Even without the vanity height it would still be the world's tallest by highest occupied floor (CTBUH's Daniel Safarik in Gulf News; Wikipedia: by ~2 m over Shanghai Tower). Spire >4 000 t of steel (Wikipedia). Opened 4 Jan 2010 (Wikipedia). Highest UAE share: Burj Al Arab 38.5% (Gulf News) - not used.
backup_unused.title: 244 metr: Bürc Xəlifənin zirvəsi boşdur
backup_unused.text: Bürc Xəlifənin hündürlüyü 828 metrdir, amma ən yuxarı istifadə olunan mərtəbə 585 metrdədir. Qalan 244 metr içində heç kim yaşamayan şpildir.
reel_beats: Dubaydakı Bürc Xəlifə dünyanın ən hündür binasıdır: 828 metr. Amma ən yuxarı mərtəbə, insanların gedə bildiyi yer, 585 metrdədir.
Qalan 244 metr iti şpildir, içində demək olar ki, yer yoxdur. Bu, binanın 29 faizidir. Buna «təkəbbür hündürlüyü» deyirlər.
2013-cü ildə hesablayıblar ki, bu boş hissə ayrıca bina olsaydı, Avropanın 11-ci ən hündür binası olardı. Səncə, bu, lazımsız xərcdir, yoxsa gözəllik?
backup_unused.caption:
Dünyanın ən hündür binasının 244 metri boşdur 🏙️

Bürc Xəlifənin hündürlüyü 828 metrdir. Amma ən yuxarı istifadə olunan mərtəbə 585 metrdədir. Ondan yuxarıdakı 244 metr iti şpildir — içində demək olar ki, istifadə olunan yer yoxdur. Hündür binalar üzrə beynəlxalq şura 2013-cü ildə buna «təkəbbür hündürlüyü» adını verdi: bu, binanın 29 faizidir. Həmin boş hissə ayrıca bina olsaydı, o vaxt Avropanın 11-ci ən hündür binası olardı. Maraqlıdır ki, şpil olmasa belə, Bürc Xəlifə yenə də dünyanın ən hündür binası qalardı.
